name: brand-mcp-sample
description: SAMPLE: brand MCP server with DTCG design tokens, invented brands

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run check:rules
scripts.dev:auth: npm run build && wrangler dev -c wrangler.auth.jsonc --port 8787
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run && vitest run -c vitest.auth.config.ts && vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts
scripts.test:report: vitest run --reporter=json --outputFile=scripts/test-results-worker.json && vitest run -c vitest.auth.config.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=scripts/test-results-auth.json && vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=scripts/test-results-node.json
